description: Sets the monthly budget limit of the account. Lowering the limit (or setting one where there was none) applies at once. Raising or removing it needs the owner's approval: without confirmationToken it returns the change and a token; call again with the same arguments and the token once the user approved. Raising the limit does not restore hibernated servers. (permission: billing:budget) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

alertPercent.description: Alert e-mail threshold, percent of the limit (default 80).

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call (valid 10 minutes, single use). Only needed to raise or remove the limit.

dailyLimitCad.description: Optional DAILY budget limit in CAD (calendar day America/Toronto), null to remove it, omitted to keep it.

monthlyLimitCad.description: New monthly budget limit in CAD, or null to remove the limit.

name: gpucloud_set_budget
title: Set the account budget limit
